_comment: Bootstrap convenience list — NOT an authority.
Inclusion verifies only that a relay is real and reachable; never who runs it.
A client-local list ALWAYS takes precedence over this file.
This file lives in a forkable Git repo precisely so that no one controls it:
fork it, edit it, ignore it. Total-censorship fallback: whoever holds a signed
Order can call settle() directly on-chain and bypass every relay here.
Relays are NEVER paid — no fee, no reward, no token, permanent invariant.
